reference.title: AuditX Reports Structure and Data
reference.shortdesc: The Reports section in AuditX provides a complete log of all recorded events, including barcodes scanned, video recordings, and sub-event images. Reports can be searched, filtered, and exported for analysis, audits, and dispute resolution.

section.title: Report Data Fields
section.p: Each event in the AuditX Reports table contains the following information:

row.entry: The value of the barcode scanned during the event. Helps identify which item or order was processed.
Unique identifier assigned by AuditX to each recorded event. Used for tracking and linking evidence.
Name or identifier of the AuditX hardware device that recorded the event. Useful in multi-device deployments.
Number of sub-events (individual image captures or scan points) that occurred during the main event. Shown as clickable thumbnails in reports.
The main video or media file for the event. Click the icon to play the recording or download.
Length of the recorded event in minutes. Helps track total recording time for operational analysis.
Exact timestamp of when the event was recorded, displayed in the system's local time zone. Accurate to the second for audit purposes.
Indicates whether the event was linked to a webhook call or contained additional metadata. Shows status of external system integration.
The physical location (site) where the event was recorded. Used to organize reports by warehouse or fulfillment center.

section.title: Filter by Barcode or Event ID
section.p: Use the "Select Option" dropdown to choose:

ul.li: Barcode: Search for events by the barcode value scanned
Event ID: Search for a specific event using its unique identifier

section.p: Enter the search term in the search box and results will filter automatically.

section.title: Filter by Site
section.p: Use the "Sites" dropdown to view events from a specific physical location:

ul.li: Displays all sites configured in your AuditX account
Select a site to see only events from that location
Leave blank to see events from all sites

section.title: Filter by Time Period
section.p: Choose a predefined or custom date range:

ul.li: Today - Current calendar day
Last 7 days - Previous seven days including today
Last 30 days - Previous thirty days including today
Last 90 days - Previous ninety days including today
This month - Current calendar month
Last month - Previous calendar month
Start Date: Beginning date for report period
End Date: Ending date for report period (inclusive)

ol.li: Locate the event in the report table
Click the play icon in the "Events" column
The full-screen video player opens with the following features:

ul.li: Video Timeline: Scrub to any point in the video
Sub-Event Thumbnails: Shown on the right side - click to jump to that moment
Playback Controls: Play, pause, speed adjustment
Download Option: Save the video file for archiving or sharing
Annotations: Static and dynamic overlays show metadata throughout video

section.title: Sub-Event Images
section.p: To view images captured during an event:

ol.li: Click on the sub-events count in the "Sub Events" column
Thumbnails of all captured images appear in a carousel
Click any thumbnail to view the full-size image
Image metadata (barcode, timestamp, etc.) displays with each image if annotations were enabled

section.title: Exporting Report Data
section.p: AuditX allows you to export filtered report data for further analysis and archiving:

ol.li: Apply any filters to narrow the report (optional)
Click the "Download CSV" button at the bottom of the report
A CSV file is generated containing all visible report data
The file can be opened in spreadsheet applications (Excel, Google Sheets, etc.)

section.title: CSV Export Contents
section.p: The exported CSV file includes all report columns:

ul.li: Barcode values
Event IDs
System names
Event durations
Recorded timestamps
Sub-event counts
Webhook status
Site information

section.note: CSV exports are useful for data analysis, compliance reporting, and integration with external systems like ERP or BI tools.

section.title: Daily Operations Monitoring
section.p: Use "Today" filter to review all events recorded during the current shift or day. Useful for:

ul.li: Quality assurance spot checks
Supervisor shift reviews
Identifying problematic items or patterns

section.title: Dispute Resolution
section.p: Search by order ID or barcode to retrieve the complete event evidence for a specific order. The video playback and sub-event images provide comprehensive documentation of what was packed and how.

section.title: Audit Trail and Compliance
section.p: Export monthly or quarterly reports to CSV for compliance documentation. The system-generated timestamps and event IDs create an immutable audit trail suitable for regulatory reviews.

section.title: Performance Analysis
section.p: Export event duration data across multiple days to analyze packing efficiency. Identify peak hours, average event durations, and team performance metrics.

section.title: Integration Validation
section.p: Check the "Webhook / Meta" field to verify that events are being successfully sent to external systems. Failed webhook transmissions can be identified and retried.

section.title: Report Data Retention
section.p: AuditX retains event data according to your account plan:

ul.li: Standard Plan: 90 days of event data
Extended Plan: 365 days of event data
Archive Plan: Unlimited retention with export to cold storage

section.note: Download and archive important reports regularly to ensure compliance with your data retention requirements.
